description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/anisotropic_diffusion_2d_dirichlet.esm (model AnisotropicDiffusion2DDirichlet, test mms_steady_anisotropic_dirichlet) at the problem's default resolution (NX=NY=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the second-order centered DIRICHLET-wall MIXED second-derivative rule central_Dxy_dirichlet_bc (the d^2u/dx dy off-diagonal of a positive-definite anisotropic diffusion tensor K=[[1,1/2],[1/2,1]]) together with the diagonal central_D2x_dirichlet_bc + central_D2y_dirichlet_bc that make the combined operator dissipative. The homogeneous Dirichlet walls are provably well-posed (the boundary flux in the energy estimate vanishes with u=0 on the wall). The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust hangs at every tolerance tried on this stiff / non-smooth / large-AST anisotropic-diffusion RHS (same failure as anisotropic_diffusion_2d_periodic): earthsci-toolkit-rs's diffsol integrator has no dtmin/max-step fail-fast guard, so it drives dt->0 without terminating instead of erroring. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) solve it. Remove once the Rust solver gains a step guard.
